description: Requires the customer's connected Fold account. Books a pickup at one of their SAVED addresses using their saved card, gate code / access notes and laundry preferences — no payment link needed. Omit addressId to use their default address. pickupWindow must be one of the market's windows; if it is missing or invalid the response lists the valid windows and nothing is booked. Delivery is the next evening by default (Fold delivers in the evening only). sameAsLastOrder=true reuses the service, address and pickup window of the customer's most recent order (or of sameAsOrderCode, e.g. from a receipt); anything passed explicitly overrides it. This creates a real order. An optional idempotencyKey (UUID) makes retries return the same booking instead of creating a second one.

addressId.description: One of the customer's saved addressIds (from get_my_account). Default: their default address.

deliveryDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the day after pickup.

deliveryWindow.description: Evening delivery window label. Default: the market's evening window.

idempotencyKey.description: UUID recommended. Retrying with the same key returns the same booking.

notes.description: Notes for THIS order only (e.g. "wine stain on white shirt"). Standing preferences are applied automatically.

pickupWindow.description: Pickup window label, e.g. "7:30 AM – 9:30 AM".

sameAsLastOrder.description: Reuse service, address and pickup window from the most recent order ("same as last time").

sameAsOrderCode.description: Reuse service, address and pickup window from this specific past order (e.g. FOLD-24083).

name: book_my_pickup
title: Book a pickup (signed in)
